scopes.summary: Allows mergePullRequest only if the user holds maintainer role, is not the author, uses VPN; the pull request has approval and its target branch begins with 'hotfix/'.

slices.summary: Merge pull request when the user holds maintainer role, is not the author, uses VPN; the pull request has at least one approval and target branch starts with 'hotfix/'.
